title: The polar observation camp
alt: Two researchers operate a tripod-mounted instrument and record observations beside an equipment sled under an aurora.
description: Scientific-expedition imagery with distinct actions, connected equipment and an ice-field setting.
prompt: An extraordinary wide scientific expedition photograph on sea ice under a soft green aurora. Two researchers in red parkas stand beside a small weather station on a tripod and a closed yellow equipment sled. One researcher adjusts the sensor with both hands; the other writes on a clipboard. A tethered orange tent stands farther away; guy lines connect the tent to anchors in the snow. Sparse ice ridges, a dark starry sky, coherent equipment and human anatomy, photoreal natural exposure, no letters.
